title: Sam's Very Small Parade
synopsis: Sam marches with a red leaf; friends join him, and the parade accidentally gives a snail a splendid hat.

related_resources.reason: A family-play example includes parades and follow-the-leader. No tested story outcome.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: This was not a very big parade.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: One tiny imaginative premise is sufficient for a playful narrative.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: CDC lists play-parades as an example of parent-child play, not evidence about this fictional mouse parade.

source_note: Original fictional story. Parent-facing references provide context for age-appropriate playful interaction, not direct evidence about this plot or any measured developmental outcome.
